notes: Vanilla canvas 2D, no libraries. Layered side-view parallax: cached dusk sky, cirrus, sun, soft cloud blobs, two mountain ridges, hills, town lights, treeline, field, poles with sagging wires, roadside trees, guardrail, grass tufts, tarmac with scrolling aggregate and lane markings, the car, then an out-of-focus foreground strip. The car is a fastback coupe built from one silhouette path with real wheel-arch cutouts; wheels rotate with distance travelled and the body heaves and pitches on a road profile that includes periodic expansion joints. Every layer wraps modulo one span and is seeded by a deterministic index hash, so the loop has no seam. Verified in headless Chromium: no console errors.
